error.networkRetryingDescription: A network request was interrupted. Retrying once…
error.networkFailureDescription: Your browser could not complete a request. Check your connection and try again. This is usually temporary and does not mean you were signed out.

approval.regionalIntro: Current approval target from regional conditions and named effects. Stored ratings move toward this target each turn. Some named conditions also affect in-state sector profit margins.
approval.activeAfterLimits: {count, plural, one {# active effect} other {# active effects}}, after limits
approval.rankingTargets: Metric-based approval targets. Stored ratings also include temporary effects and move gradually each turn.

guidedLegislation.startingHelp: Start from a policy domain, a metric you want to affect, or a flavour-only custom bill.
guidedLegislation.noEffects: Custom bills contain flavour text only. They have no provisions and make no budget or metric changes.
guidedLegislation.required: Add a title and message body.
guidedLegislation.tooLong: Use no more than {limit, number} characters.
